newsitem.title: USA: Dillon Read confirms still in talks with ING.
newsitem.headline: Dillon Read confirms still in talks with ING.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Dillon, Read & Co said on Friday it remains in talks with Dutch financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV over their future relationship.
Dillon, Read spokesman Peter Rosenthal said the U.S. firm "has been in discussions with ING regarding the exercise of Dillon, Read's option to acquire the 25 percent interest that ING holds.
"In connection with those talks, Dillon, Read keeps receiving proposals from ING, based on ING's apparent desire that Dillon, Read not exercise its option," he said.
Rosenthal declined any further comment on the substance of the talks.
ING has said its ideas include possibly buying the 75 percent of Dillon, Read it does not own.
ING spokesman Ruud Polet said yesterday the company expects to complete talks with Dillon, Read within a couple of weeks.
"If the conditions are right for both parties, it would be nice to have it all," Polet told Reuters in Amsterdam.
